#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regression tests for doctest exception-note comparisons."""

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
import doctest  # noqa: E402


def raise_with_notes(exception, *notes):
    for note in notes:
        exception.add_note(note)
    raise exception


class ExceptionNotesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_doctest(self, source):
        test = doctest.DocTestParser().get_doctest(
            source,
            {"raise_with_notes": raise_with_notes},
            self.id(),
            __file__,
            0,
        )
        return doctest.DocTestRunner(verbose=False).run(test, out=lambda _: None)

    def assert_doctest_result(self, source, *, failed, attempted=1):
        result = self.run_doctest(source)
        self.assertEqual(result.failed, failed)
        self.assertEqual(result.attempted, attempted)

    def test_ordinary_exception_without_notes(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result("""
            >>> raise ValueError("plain message")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: plain message
        """, failed=0)

    def test_ordinary_exception_note(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result("""
            >>> raise_with_notes(ValueError("ordinary message"), "ordinary note")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: ordinary message
            ordinary note
        """, failed=0)

    def test_multiple_notes_are_all_compared(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result("""
            >>> raise_with_notes(RuntimeError("many notes"), "first note", "second note")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            RuntimeError: many notes
            first note
            second note
        """, failed=0)

        self.assert_doctest_result("""
            >>> raise_with_notes(RuntimeError("many notes"), "first note", "second note")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            RuntimeError: many notes
            incorrect first note
            second note
        """, failed=1)

    def test_syntax_error_family_ignores_location_but_compares_notes(self):
        for exception_type in (SyntaxError, IndentationError):
            with self.subTest(exception_type=exception_type.__name__):
                source = f'''\
                    >>> raise_with_notes(
                    ...     {exception_type.__name__}(
                    ...         "invalid syntax",
                    ...         ("actual.py", 23, 5, "bad source\\n"),
                    ...     ),
                    ...     "syntax note",
                    ... )
                    Traceback (most recent call last):
                    ...
                    {exception_type.__name__}: invalid syntax
                    syntax note
                '''
                self.assert_doctest_result(source, failed=0)

                self.assert_doctest_result(
                    source.replace("syntax note\n", "incorrect syntax note\n", 1),
                    failed=1,
                )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
